author: Unity
description:
Learn how to create and manage IAP Webshops directly from the Unity Dashboard.

In this tutorial, we’ll walk through:
✅ Setting up a new Webshop.
✅ Customizing the look and feel of your store with theme generation.
✅ Connecting your IAP catalog and payment provider.
✅ Testing your storefront with the mock catalog.
✅ Integrating your Webshop into your Unity game.

Learn more: 
🔗 Official documentation: https://on.unity.com/D2C_Workflow
🔗 Discussion Article: https://on.unity.com/IAP54_Discussions
🔗 Gem Hunter UGS Reference Project: https://on.unity.com/GemHunter_Blog

[0:00] Introduction to IAP Webshops
[0:25] Creating Your First Webshop
[1:05] Testing with the Mock Catalog
[1:54] Customizing the Store with Theme Generation
[2:56] Managing & Adding Production Catalog Listings
[3:34] Setting Up Payment Providers
[4:02] Simulating a Purchase Checkout Flow
[4:26] How to Open and Integrate the Webshop From Your Game
